reviews.title: Getting worse
reviews.text:
The MobiDrive integration is abysmal.

If you're working on a file that you sync with MobiDrive and you want to share that file, you cannot do so until it has sync'd with MobiDrive again, even though the file was already sync'd and is available offline. This adds an always-online requirement, which is ridiculous for a mobile office app as the whole point of it existing is to make edits while traveling.

You can see from the developer response below that the firm doesn't understand the issue about sharing edited files at all. They think I'm talking about opening and saving. I want to be able to attach an edited file to an email via the share sheet while I'm offline, and I can't. The app insists in syncing first - which it cannot do offline.

It asks for a review nearly every day, which is very annoying and I'm sure violates App Store rules.

I used to give this app 5 starts but all the issues that have been added to it recently have ruined it. They tried a new UI which was awful but thankfully they backtracked and restored the old one. It's the best UI of any mobile office app, but the app now lags behind on features and is overpriced for what it is. It was the clear leader in 2022 but they aren't adding anything useful anymore - just bugs and nag-screens and rebrands. The firm seems determined to make the app awful and irrelevant. I'd guess there's a battle going on within management.

- Understand and fix the MobiDrive issue. It's catastrophic.
- Align your nag-screens with

reviews.title: iPad keyboard functionality neglected
reviews.text:
Do you use this app on your iPad with a keyboard? Then don't expect to have a good time. A major keyboard functionality is broken where you can't delete words with Option+Backspace.
I've submitted a bug but it has yet to be fixed. Additionally the issue has gotten worse. It used to only impact when the cursor was at the end of a line of text, but now it also impacts when you're at the end of a word or punctuation. This inconsistency and lack of turn-around for, what I consider, a critical functionality, has lead me to give a 1-star review. Fix this issue and I'll give it a proper 5-star review.
